mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, customer_id, appointment_date, appointment_time, duration, total_amount, status, notes, rating, review, booking_source, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.booking_source, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, c.country_code as customer_country_code, mt.id as membership_tier_id, mt.name as membership_tier_name, mt.color as membership_tier_color, mt.icon as membership_tier_icon, aps.id as appointment_service_id, aps.service_id as appointment_service_service_id, aps.service_name as appointment_service_name, aps.price as appointment_service_price, aps.duration as appointment_service_duration, ar.id as appointment_resource_id, ar.resource_id as appointment_resource_resource_id, ar.resource_type as appointment_resource_type, ar.is_primary as appointment_resource_is_primary, ar.created_at as appointment_resource_created_at FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN membership_tier mt ON c.membership_tier_id = mt.id LEFT JOIN appointment_services aps ON a.id = aps.appointment_id LEFT JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.booking_source, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, c.country_code as customer_country_code, mt.id as membership_tier_id, mt.name as membership_tier_name, mt.color as membership_tier_color, mt.icon as membership_tier_icon, aps.id as appointment_service_id, aps.service_id as appointment_service_service_id, aps.service_name as appointment_service_name, aps.price as appointment_service_price, aps.duration as appointment_service_duration, ar.id as appointment_resource_id, ar.resource_id as appointment_resource_resource_id, ar.resource_type as appointment_resource_type, ar.is_primary as appointment_resource_is_primary, ar.created_at as appointment_resource_created_at FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN membership_tier mt ON c.membership_tier_id = mt.id LEFT JOIN appointment_services aps ON a.id = aps.appointment_id LEFT JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.appointment_date DESC, a.appointment_time DESC
SELECT FROM appointments WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY appointment_date DESC, appointment_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM appointments WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND rating IS NOT NULL

SELECT id, appointment_id as appointmentId, service_id as serviceId, service_name as serviceName, price, duration, created_at as createdAt FROM appointment_services WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId}

mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.reminder_24h_sent, a.reminder_30min_sent, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, c.country_code as customer_country_code, mt.id as membership_tier_id, mt.name as membership_tier_name, mt.color as membership_tier_color, mt.icon as membership_tier_icon, aps.id as appointment_service_id, aps.service_id as appointment_service_service_id, aps.service_name as appointment_service_name, aps.price as appointment_service_price, aps.duration as appointment_service_duration, ar.id as appointment_resource_id, ar.resource_id as appointment_resource_resource_id, r.name as appointment_resource_name, ar.resource_type as appointment_resource_type, ar.is_primary as appointment_resource_is_primary, ar.created_at as appointment_resource_created_at FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN membership_tier mt ON c.membership_tier_id = mt.id LEFT JOIN appointment_services aps ON a.id = aps.appointment_id LEFT JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id LEFT JOIN resource r ON ar.resource_id = r.id WHERE a.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id WHERE a.appointment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND a.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id WHERE a.appointment_date = #{date} AND a.appointment_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND a.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY a.appointment_time

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, c.country_code as customer_country_code, mt.id as membership_tier_id, mt.name as membership_tier_name, mt.color as membership_tier_color, mt.icon as membership_tier_icon, aps.id as appointment_service_id, aps.service_id as appointment_service_service_id, aps.service_name as appointment_service_name, aps.price as appointment_service_price, aps.duration as appointment_service_duration, ar.id as appointment_resource_id, ar.resource_id as appointment_resource_resource_id, ar.resource_type as appointment_resource_type, ar.is_primary as appointment_resource_is_primary, ar.created_at as appointment_resource_created_at FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN membership_tier mt ON c.membership_tier_id = mt.id LEFT JOIN appointment_services aps ON a.id = aps.appointment_id LEFT JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id WHERE a.appointment_date = #{date} AND a.appointment_time = #{time} AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, c.country_code as customer_country_code, mt.id as membership_tier_id, mt.name as membership_tier_name, mt.color as membership_tier_color, mt.icon as membership_tier_icon, aps.id as appointment_service_id, aps.service_id as appointment_service_service_id, aps.service_name as appointment_service_name, aps.price as appointment_service_price, aps.duration as appointment_service_duration, ar.id as appointment_resource_id, ar.resource_id as appointment_resource_resource_id, ar.resource_type as appointment_resource_type, r.name as appointment_resource_name, ar.is_primary as appointment_resource_is_primary, ar.created_at as appointment_resource_created_at FROM appointments a INNER JOIN orders o ON a.id = o.appointment_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN membership_tier mt ON c.membership_tier_id = mt.id LEFT JOIN appointment_services aps ON a.id = aps.appointment_id LEFT JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id LEFT JOIN resource r ON ar.resource_id = r.id AND ar.resource_type = 'STAFF' WHERE DATE(a.appointment_date) = #{date} AND a.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.payment_status = 'paid' ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, c.country_code as customer_country_code, mt.id as membership_tier_id, mt.name as membership_tier_name, mt.color as membership_tier_color, mt.icon as membership_tier_icon, aps.id as appointment_service_id, aps.service_id as appointment_service_service_id, aps.service_name as appointment_service_name, aps.price as appointment_service_price, aps.duration as appointment_service_duration, ar.id as appointment_resource_id, ar.resource_id as appointment_resource_resource_id, ar.resource_type as appointment_resource_type, r.name as appointment_resource_name, ar.is_primary as appointment_resource_is_primary, ar.created_at as appointment_resource_created_at FROM appointments a INNER JOIN orders o ON a.id = o.appointment_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN membership_tier mt ON c.membership_tier_id = mt.id LEFT JOIN appointment_services aps ON a.id = aps.appointment_id LEFT JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id LEFT JOIN resource r ON ar.resource_id = r.id AND ar.resource_type = 'STAFF' WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(a.appointment_date) = #{date} AND a.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.payment_status = 'paid' ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM appointments WHERE status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') ORDER BY tenant_id
